The '''Albacore''' is a [[fish]] that can be caught in the ocean at [[The Beach]] or on the [[Farm Maps#Beach|Beach Farm]] during [[Fall]] and [[Winter]] in the early morning and at night. It may also randomly appear in [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Wednesday|Wednesdays]] for {{Price|200}}, or at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|75}}.

Albacore can be caught regardless of time of day or season using [[Magic Bait]].

==Map==
Albacore can be found in the ocean.

==Tailoring==
Albacore can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[Tailoring|Sailor Shirt]].  [[File:Shirt259a.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a blue dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Fish Pond==
Albacore can be placed in a [[Fish Pond]], where they will reproduce every 2 days. The initial pond capacity is 3 fish, but the capacity can be increased to 10 by completing three quests. The only possible output is blue Albacore [[Roe]].

==Quests==
*[[Gus]] requests an albacore by mail on the 26th of [[Winter]] in the [[Quests#Fish Stew|"Fish Stew" quest]].  The reward is {{Price|400}} and 1 [[Friendship]] heart.
*'''Fishing:''' [[Willy]] may randomly request 1-4 albacore in [[Fall]] or [[Winter]] at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]] for a reward of {{Price|75}} per fish.  (You get to keep the fish).
*'''Aquatic Overpopulation:''' [[Demetrius]] may request 10 Albacore to be caught in [[Fall]] at the [[Quests#List of Special Orders|Special Orders Board]] outside the [[Mayor's Manor]] for a reward of gold equivalent to selling the fish and the [[Farm Computer]] recipe.
